shared_marketing_content_model.core_value_proposition: Structured, voice-and-video conversational first-round interviews led by Nova — grounding every competency rating in verbatim candidate evidence while leaving the final hiring call to human teams.

verified_nova_capabilities.name: Adaptive Conversational Probing
verified_nova_capabilities.summary: Adapts follow-ups to candidate answers, asks for elaboration when needed, and advances gracefully after repeated unclear responses.

verified_nova_capabilities.name: Live State Transparency & Captions
verified_nova_capabilities.summary: Real-time visual state awareness (Listening, Thinking, Speaking) with persistent, synchronized interview question captions.

verified_nova_capabilities.name: Evidence-Linked Competency Scorecard
verified_nova_capabilities.summary: Every score links directly to candidate quotes and identified evidence gaps, supporting a distinct 'Needs Review' state instead of artificial pass/fail binaries.

verified_nova_capabilities.name: Structured Recruiter Pipeline
verified_nova_capabilities.summary: Job-specific knockout screening, candidate stages (Sourced to Offer), reusable talent pools, and shareable hiring reports.

competency_highlight.title: System Fault Tolerance & Partitioning
competency_highlight.candidate_quote: "We segregated our raft consensus into three regional quorum rings. When cross-region latency spiked over 280ms, our lease coordinator degraded writes to local write-ahead logs rather than stalling the client buffer."
competency_highlight.justification: Candidate accurately articulated distributed consensus partitioning and degradation trade-offs under high network partition latency.
competency_highlight.missing_evidence: Did not detail data reconciliation mechanics after regional partitions heal.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.file_extension_rule: Use .js and .jsx files exclusively. Do not generate .tsx files.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.testing_attributes: All interactive elements (concept switchers, state tabs, demo modal triggers, form inputs, modal close buttons) MUST have data-testid attributes.
anti_ai_slop_rules: NO generic centered cards with uniform gradients.
NO robot, brain, or crystal ball emojis (🤖, 🧠, 💡, 🔮).
NO unverified claims ('100% bias free', 'Production verified', fake 99.4% accuracy stats).
NO fake client logos or unsupported partner badges (e.g. Workday, Greenhouse, Ashby).
Headers and overlays must never have fully transparent backgrounds.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.surface_and_contrast: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 text contrast for all body and metadata. Never use text-7xl or text-8xl for headings; keep maximum H1 at text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.illustrative_disclaimer: Both previews must visibly state: 'Interactive Design Concept Preview — Illustrative Product Demonstration'.
